title: Embedded OLE object pptx 002
notes: real package-level OLE plumbing modeled on how PowerPoint writes legacy embeds: ppt/embeddings/object1.bin carries a 1x1 PNG byte stub under the oleObject part — the same honest type/content mismatch the docx counterpart uses in its 001 (declared oleObject content type, PNG magic inside), ProgID Paint.Picture, and the v:shape declares Type=Embed regardless: a consumer that sniffs magic vs one that trusts the declared type will disagree, which is exactly what this instance probes, declared with the oleObject relationship type in ppt/slides/_rels/slide1.xml.rels and a Content_Types override. The slide carries an mc:AlternateContent whose mc:Choice Requires="v" holds a v:shape with o:ole=rIdN + o:OLEObject child (Type=Embed, DrawAspect=Icon) and an empty mc:Fallback; the p:sld root gains xmlns:mc + mc:Ignorable="v o" via zip rewrite. Synthetic layout, not schema-validated: LibreOffice may show an icon, render nothing, or drop the parts — tolerance varies by consumer and is what the fixture probes. The embed carries no text truth, so reference_text covers only the three body lines.
